findings.note: The programme as described may no longer exist.
findings.resolution: The Vanier programme as described on this page is closed: applications are no longer accepted and the page points to the new harmonized Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program. findings.resolution_evidence: We are no longer accepting applications for the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships. Please refer to the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program web page for information regarding the new harmonized program.

findings.sentence: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship holders receive a monthly allowance of €1,200 (from January 2026), to which is added several services: International transportation, national transportation, insurance, housing searches, cultural activities, etc.
findings.note: Distinct amounts on one page: €1,200 (eiffel-1); €2,000 (eiffel-1).
findings.resolution: Not a contradiction. The page gives the amounts under separate level headings: €1,200/month is the Master's level allowance, €2,000/month is the Doctorate level stipend, both from January 2026. Tuition fees are not covered at either level.
findings.resolution_evidence: Master's level. France Excellence Eiffel scholarship holders receive a monthly allowance of €1,200 (from January 2026). Doctorate level. France Excellence Eiffel scholarship holders receive a monthly stipend of €2,000 (from January 2026).

findings.note: Distinct amounts on one page: HK$14,400 (hkpfs-0); HK$344,400 (hkpfs-0); US$1,840 (hkpfs-0); US$44,150 (hkpfs-0).
findings.resolution: Not two stipends. HK$344,400 and approximately US$44,150 are the same 2026/27 annual stipend expressed in two currencies. Quote both figures with the year, and keep the 'approximately' on the US dollar figure.
findings.resolution_evidence: In the 2026/27 academic year, the Fellowship provides an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150).
